codeReview.summary: The shared-components commit moves the cards toward the Cellar Ledger palette and border-only treatment, but it does not fully satisfy the feature contract. The StatsCard icon circle misses the required 10px radius, and WorkerCard now exposes a visible call button that is rendered as a button but has no action attached.

issues.description: The feature contract requires StatsCard's tinted icon circle to be 36x36 with a 10px radius, but this implementation uses `borderRadius.sm`. In `src/styles/theme.ts`, `borderRadius.sm` resolves to 4, so the card does not match the required Cellar Ledger shape.

WorkerCard adds a new phone/call control as a `Pressable`, but the element has no `onPress` handler. It is announced as a button via accessibility props yet tapping it does nothing, which creates a dead interactive control in the redesigned component.

sharedStateObservations.observation: When the orchestrator completed this feature manually after worker crashes, the mission artifacts did not record a feature handoff or transcript entry for the completed work. Review had to infer the relevant commit from git history instead of using the standard mission evidence trail.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: progress_log.jsonl:8-15 shows both `update-shared-components` worker sessions crashed and the mission continued manually; `handoffs/` only contains JSON files for `update-design-tokens` and `update-tab-bar`; `worker-transcripts.jsonl` contains only two entries for those same features.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `ui-worker` skill assumes a screen-specific wireframe workflow, but this shared-components feature has no wireframe path or alternate review recipe documented. That makes the skill a poor fit for component-only theme work, especially when the feature is later completed manually.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json:623-641 defines component expectations only for `update-shared-components`; `.factory/skills/ui-worker/SKILL.md` Step 2 requires reading both light and dark `wireframe-{name}.html` files for the assigned screen.

summary: Fail: the redesign generally aligns with Cellar Ledger tokens, but StatsCard still misses a required 10px icon-circle radius, and WorkerCard introduces a non-functional call button. Report written from git/history review because this manually completed feature has no dedicated handoff/transcript artifact.
